program_name: Bachelor in Visual Communication and Marketing (Hons)

fees.notes: StudyMalaysia course page: international fees RM79,880. MSU official programme pages publish Malaysian fees only; no official international fee schedule available. Source: https://studymalaysia.com/what/course/MSU/0054127/ (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: You need to pass STPM or equivalent with at least a C (CGPA 2.00) in two (2) subjects and pass Mathematics and English Language at SPM level or pass STAM with Jayyid or UEC with a B in five (5) subjects including Mathematics and English or Matriculation/Foundation with 2.00 CGPA or SAM with 65%-70% aggregate score or CPU with 80% aggregate score pass with 2.00 CGPA or obtain a Diploma (MQF Level 4) with at least 2.00 CGPA or any other qualifications recognized as equivalent by the Government of Malaysia. You must also pass the MSU interview and drawing test AND obtain Band 1 in MUET. International students must score at least 5.5 on the IELTS or equivalent.
